def solve(nums, k):

        store_index = left
        for i in range(left, right):
            if values[i] > pivot:
                values[store_index], values[i] = values[i], values[store_index]
                store_index += 1
        values[right], values[store_index] = values[store_index], values[right]
        return store_index

        pivot_index = random.randint(left, right)
        pivot_index = partition(left, right, pivot_index)
        if pivot_index == k_smallest:
            return
        elif pivot_index < k_smallest:
            quickselect(pivot_index + 1, right, k_smallest)
        else:
            quickselect(left, pivot_index - 1, k_smallest)

    random.seed(42)
    quickselect(0, len(values) - 1, len(values) - k)
    return [keys[i] for i in range(len(values) - k, len(values))]
